objective: Verify appointment booking, status changes, scheduling conflicts, scoped access and lead handoffs.
scope: Current lead ownership and shared calendar locking
Audit recovery, timezone validation and browser acceptance

acceptance.description: Current CRM scope, booking conflicts and timezone normalization
acceptance.evidence: Concurrent requests on different leads reject overlaps for the same counselor and allow adjacent or different-counselor slots. Tests cover conflict pagination, active assignee and queued ownership checks, and strict timezone/date normalization.

acceptance.description: Reschedule, outcome, stale edits and audit recovery
acceptance.evidence: Service tests cover reschedule reasons, cancellation, completion, no-show timing, stale and terminal edits, failed audit intent and committed writes with a lost acknowledgment. Browser verified booking and outcomes.

acceptance.description: Handoff conflict checks, version transfer and partial failure recovery
acceptance.evidence: Conflict preflight runs before writes. Tests verify handoff scope/version transfer, blocked unassignment with a booking, and interrupted retry without bumping already moved appointment versions.

acceptance.description: Built-app browser workflow and project verification
acceptance.evidence: Actual built-app synthetic browser checks passed booking, conflict feedback, required reschedule reason, cancellation, no-show and local start/end display. Read-only Appwrite checks verified the private collection and owner/lead query shapes. Typecheck, all 104 tests and build passed.

nextActions.action: Archive CAL-01 and start bounded DOC-01 verification for private document uploads, download authorization, review and recovery.
Keep appointment and case reminder adapters and production rollout separately gated. Use the appointment recovery guide during operator acceptance.

knownRisks: Appointment/case reminder adapters remain separately gated; external provider delivery is not configured.
Crash-left cycle/lead locks fail closed; recovery requires stopping their owners before targeted operator removal. No expiry takeover.
Task creation/change audit acknowledgments can be ambiguous; inspect recorded task ID/current version before retrying to avoid duplicate work.
Reminder inbox scans 25 stored records per page; task lists still cap at 100. Recurrence/escalation/snooze and provider outbox remain follow-up features.
Runtime health is stale after three minutes without a recorded cycle; a long cycle or delayed clock can also cause stale status. No external alerting provider is configured.
VPS deployment, Nginx/TLS/PM2 reboot smoke checks and production worker activation remain unperformed.
Development branch still contains unaccepted documents/team/reporting modules; whole-branch main merge is gated.

Application ownership transfer is multi-record and not transactional; an interrupted handoff can leave metadata ahead of the lead owner. Existing current-lead scope checks hide records from the wrong counselor; retry/reconciliation still needs feature acceptance.
Scheduling writes share one calendar lock. Partial handoffs may need operator retry, and moved slots remain reserved on the target calendar while the lead remains with its prior owner.
